gates.name: support.package-surfaces.integration
gates.notes: Includes Support package purchase/draining/expiry, Executive customer evidence, native managed Field case and the full Support consumer fences. The native Field fixture tool env is supplied by scripts/testing/runtime-tooling.ts (preview/HEIF/Poppler/ClamAV).

gates.name: support workflows
gates.notes: Prior desktop/mobile browser evidence covers tickets, SLA, incidents, sessions/capabilities and evidence bind/revoke.

legacy.support_page: The Support cases page delegates to the native Support presenter and no longer imports the Sales customer hub screen or its TypeScript supportWorkspace reader.
legacy.remaining: Retained TypeScript Support read/provider bridges are other-owner consumers with named removal conditions; no Support production route uses the legacy page reader.

fixes: The profile notes read falls back to the retained TS notes reader only when next/headers is outside a request scope (integration fixtures); production requests use the native notes transport.
The Executive customer-evidence test window now includes the current fixture event date.
The native Field fixture declares fieldServiceReads/financeJournalReads prerequisites for its managed Support case.
The generic files attachment router is not mounted when the field-files providers already own the same attachment routes, and the field-files provider gate is feature-aware.
